summary: Pad MXFP8 projection storage for non-N8 tensor-parallel shards
compatibility: B12X MXFP8 projections preserve their logical output dimensions and bias values while aligning physical packed storage to eight columns.
details: Zero weight rows use neutral E8M0 scales; callers receive a view excluding the storage tail.
GLM TP3 fused KDA projections with 8598 output columns prepare and execute using 8600 storage columns.
